entries.title: Loren now returns REAL listings — search bug fixed, live counts, timestamps
bullets: Fixed the search: it was asking the database for a column that doesn't exist, so every search silently returned zero. Loren now queries the real listings table the same way the site does (approved + active — 18,080 live listings).
Loren now reports the true total — 'how many properties for sale in Aventura' returns the actual number, and results show 'showing X of N matches'.
Property-type wording is normalized, so typing multifamily correctly matches Multi-Family in the data.
Added timestamps under every message, and bound credit metering to the BRiX wallet — kept in ledger-only mode (records cost, charges nothing) until we flip it on.
Model is gpt-4o-mini — the cost-effective choice for routing and short summaries.
entries.bench: orchestrator v3 deployed live · real data source · true counts · timestamps · brix binding (ledger-only) · 0 existing files modified

entries.title: Loren now answers — ask bar wired to the live orchestrator, results render inline
bullets: The home ask bar (and the example chips) now open a real working session at /loren/c.
Typing a request calls the live orchestrator; Loren decides to run Property Search and streams back a reply.
Matching listings render as inline cards — price, location, type, cap rate, size — each linking to the existing property page.
